# Connection attempt timeout for database access

A database connection attempt must timeout after the number of seconds specified by KC_DB_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (default 120) rather than hanging indefinitely.

To ensure callers do not hang unreasonably long on failed or black-holed database connections, improving system robustness.
